note: Times are seconds in the episode. Line texts must match LINES in main.js (the audio step checks). Edit this file and push: the audio step remakes only what changed, then renders.

pentol.design: A cheerful four-year-old Indonesian girl with a small, bright, slightly breathy voice. Curious, a little shy, speaks slowly in natural everyday Jakarta Indonesian.
pentol.preview: Mama, lihat! Ada sapi di jalan. Pentol mau lihat sapinya. Tadi Pentol deg-degan, tapi sekarang Pentol berani. Imunisasi itu sakitnya cuma sebentar, kan?

mama.design: A warm, gentle Indonesian woman in her early thirties. Soft, calm and reassuring, smiling while she talks, unhurried pace, natural Jakarta Indonesian.
mama.preview: Pagi, sayang. Hari ini kita ke rumah sakit, ya. Nggak apa-apa kalau deg-degan. Mama ada di sini, Mama peluk kamu terus. Nanti kita pulang bareng, ya.

papa.design: A friendly Indonesian man in his mid thirties with a warm, medium-low voice. Playful and a little goofy, laughs at himself easily, natural Jakarta Indonesian.
papa.preview: Wah, sandal Papa beda sebelah! Papa dulu juga deg-degan waktu imunisasi, lho. Tapi habis itu badan Papa jadi kuat. Yuk, kita berangkat bareng-bareng.

dokter.design: A kind Indonesian male doctor in his forties. Calm, clear and gentle, speaks slowly and warmly to a small child, a soft smile in the voice.
dokter.preview: Halo, Pentol. Om dokter mau dengar jantungmu dulu, ya. Dug, dug, dug. Bagus sekali. Rasanya nanti sakit sebentar saja. Kalau mau nangis, boleh, ya.

perawat.design: A bright, friendly young Indonesian woman, a nurse. Cheerful and caring, clear and gentle, speaks to children with warmth.
perawat.preview: Pentol! Ayo masuk, giliran kamu sekarang. Wah, Pentol hebat sekali hari ini. Ini stiker buat anak yang berani. Mau ditempel di mana, sayang?

narator.design: A warm Indonesian woman reading a picture book aloud to toddlers at bedtime. Slow, soft, gently smiling storyteller voice, clear Indonesian.
narator.preview: Di dalam badan Pentol, ada banyak penjaga kecil. Mereka selalu siap menjaga Pentol. Hari ini, penjaga mau belajar kenal sama kuman. Yuk, kita lihat bareng.

penjaga.design: A tiny, cute, bouncy voice for a friendly little round guardian creature in a children's cartoon. High, cheerful and enthusiastic, speaking Indonesian.
penjaga.preview: Kami ingat kamu! Kami penjaga badan Pentol. Kami sudah belajar, jadi kami kenal kuman ini. Ayo, teman-teman, kita jaga Pentol sama-sama. Hore!

lines.text: Mama peluk Pentol. Papa pegang tangan Pentol.
Di dalam badan Pentol, ada penjaga.
Obatnya bawa kuman yang lemah. Penjaga belajar.
Kuman datang? Penjaga sudah kenal. Badan Pentol kuat.
Ingat ya! Imunisasi sakitnya sebentar. Boleh nangis.
Mama dan Papa selalu ada di dekatmu.
Imunisasi bantu penjaga kenal kuman. Badan jadi kuat!

music.style: Gentle instrumental music for a toddler picture-book cartoon. Home key F major (worry in D minor). Warm, close, handmade, lots of space: few notes, long holds, soft attacks. Plucked nylon guitar or ukulele, music box, glockenspiel, soft piano, woodblock, light shaker, occasional angklung. No drum kit, no synth bass, no brass, no vocals. Keep the 1 to 4 kHz range clear for a child's voice.

pagi.prompt: Pagi: a bright, easy everyday morning, 92 BPM in F major. Plucked ukulele, light shaker, a little glockenspiel melody. Loops cleanly.

degdegan.prompt: Deg-degan: a small child feeling unsure but safe, never scary. 70 BPM in D minor. Soft piano or a low plucked line alone, long notes, no percussion.

peluk.prompt: Peluk: warm and held, a parent's hug. 72 BPM in F major. Soft piano with a gentle string pad.

jalan.prompt: Jalan: a light journey moving forward, a short car ride through the countryside. 100 BPM in F major. Woodblock tick-tock, pizzicato strings, shaker.

penasaran.prompt: Penasaran: curious and playful, exploring inside the body. 96 BPM in F major. Music box, pizzicato, glockenspiel, woodblock. Very sparse, plays under narration.

hore.prompt: Hore: a small proud win, joyful but not loud. 100 BPM in F major. Angklung and glockenspiel melody, light shaker, rising at the end.

ingat.prompt: Ingat ya: steady and reassuring recap. 80 BPM in F major. Soft plucked pulse and music box. A clean ending on a held chord.

malam.prompt: Malam: sleepy and safe at bedtime. 62 BPM in F major. Music box alone, slow lullaby melody.

page.prompt: A single thick paper page of a children's pop-up book being turned, soft and close

creak.prompt: The hard cover of a big old picture book opening slowly, soft paper and spine creak

thump.prompt: A big hardcover book closing gently on a wooden table, soft thump

whoosh.prompt: A soft magical sparkly whoosh for a children's cartoon transition

car.prompt: A small toy-like cartoon car puttering along a country road, gentle and cute, steady

cow.prompt: A friendly cow mooing once in a field, far away and soft

chicken.prompt: A hen clucking softly in a village yard

bird.prompt: A small bird chirping happily outside a window

heartbeat.prompt: A calm child's heartbeat heard through a doctor's stethoscope, dug dug dug, soft

sticker.prompt: A sticker being peeled off and pressed on, small and crisp

chime.prompt: One single glockenspiel note in F with a soft ring, gentle

aha.prompt: A quick sparkling glockenspiel run going up, light and happy

sakit.prompt: One low, soft plucked note that rings out slowly, gentle and calm
